benchmark_metadata.description: Ground-truth evaluation for ConduitAI on two synthetic OT plants: a 220 kV power substation and a municipal water-treatment plant (60,000 pcap packets, 40,000 firewall rows, 74 endpoints, 4 undocumented / bypass assets).

flow_classifications.prescribed_cutover_action: Stream spontaneous IEC-104 ASDUs unidirectionally across ARCH_A TX -> RX slave replica.

flow_classifications.function_detail: Outbound NERC CIP-007 ESP security event logs to utility SOC SIEM
flow_classifications.prescribed_cutover_action: Forward UDP/514 one-way across ARCH_A TX -> RX.

flow_classifications.function_detail: Inbound EMS STARTDT & General Interrogation polling standby RTU560 and SIPROTEC 5
flow_classifications.prescribed_cutover_action: Configure ARCH_A TX as local IEC-104 master inside ESP and point Regional EMS to ARCH_A RX replica.

flow_classifications.function_detail: Inbound DNP3 FC 0x01 Class 0/1/2 Read & COMTRADE fault sync (including Shadow Relays .29 & .49)
flow_classifications.prescribed_cutover_action: Configure ARCH_A TX local DNP3 master poller on VLAN 220 and expose RX DNP3 outstation emulator to SCADA.

flow_classifications.function_detail: Inbound Modbus FC 03 Read Holding Registers for 250MVA transformer dissolved gas analysis (DGA)
flow_classifications.prescribed_cutover_action: Poll SITRAM DGA & ION8650 meters locally via ARCH_A TX and serve replica registers on RX.

flow_classifications.function_detail: Unauthorized inbound IEC-104 TypeID 45 (C_SC_NA_1) Single Command breaker trip (Industroyer2 pattern) from corporate MPLS host
flow_classifications.prescribed_cutover_action: Physically eliminate inbound command injection path at Layer 1/2 using ARCH_A_FIELD_DIODE.

flow_classifications.function_detail: Unauthorized direct SSH interactive login attempts from corporate WAN into Hirschmann switch & bay relay
flow_classifications.prescribed_cutover_action: Physically sever inbound TCP/22 across ESP boundary via ARCH_A_FIELD_DIODE.

expected_hardware_bom.physical_mounting_constraint_note: Mounts natively on substation marshalling DIN-rail or via a passive 1U DIN-rail tray in the open 1U slot visible in server_rack_open_1u.jpg.
expected_hardware_bom.sizing_justification: 42.0 Mbps peak * 1.25 headroom = 52.5 Mbps fits comfortably under ARCH_A_FIELD_DIODE's 80 Mbps sustained ceiling (100 Mbps max), <= 32 polled OT IEDs/RTUs, single station bus VLAN 220, and ARCH_A natively supports all 4 required substation protocols (IEC_104, DNP3, MODBUS_TCP, SYSLOG_UDP) for SL-4 isolation at minimal cost ($4,500).

primary_recommendation.name: Edge Video & IoT Unidirectional Proxy Diode

accepted_alternative_boms.description: 2x ARCH_A_FIELD_DIODE load-split across Modbus dosing & telemetry conduits (2 * 80 Mbps = 160 Mbps sustained >= 81.25 Mbps, DIN_RAIL 130mm total)

expected_hardware_bom.physical_mounting_constraint_note: plc_cabinet_din_rail.jpg and blueprint title block confirm DIN-rail-only field cabinet mounting (zero 19-inch server rack space); ARCH_C (1U_19INCH_RACK only) is prohibited without a cabinet upgrade.
expected_hardware_bom.sizing_justification: 65.0 Mbps peak * 1.25 headroom = 81.25 Mbps slightly exceeds a single ARCH_A_FIELD_DIODE's 80.0 Mbps sustained ceiling, AND Scenario 4 requires both MODBUS_TCP PLC register polling (ARCH_A) and high-rate HTTPS_PUSH EPA compliance streaming (ARCH_B, DIN_RAIL 110mm, 800 Mbps sustained) while respecting DIN-rail physical constraints.
